name: autocontinue gate: a run journaling milestones alone still reaches the push cap

source.assertion: Regression pin for the push-cap defect diagnosed against a live operator run: the unattended-run contract requires every milestone to be journaled with oso-state journal on the very push that orders it, so a run that is genuinely stuck still grows its own journal turn after turn. Progress toward the cap must be measured by the run's own state file, which only a real oso-state set changes, never by journal growth a milestone alone can manufacture.
